text: Refines D-0322 for #572: an existing Python application's conformance check batch stays out of the evidence fingerprint, as the TLC resource history does, because it records how the checker scheduled its TLC work rather than what the work found. The receipt still shows each batch. #565 renamed ask3d's starting-state batch from "." to "init-1", which changed its fingerprint from sha256:58c706e1846b to sha256:1fbe544e094d with every count, verdict and state the same, and #549's step 3 will make batches depend on scheduling too.
